positions.name: RollbackRehearsalCadence
positions.frame: what cadence governs Atlas rollback rehearsals, and on what operational basis?
positions.why: src-2 directs monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals; src-3 supplies the rationale that an unrehearsed rollback is one not actually possessed; src-4 and src-5 record the decision's cadence and owner. All four cohere under the question of what cadence is set and on what operational grounding — the directive, its justification, and the summary record of the same decision.
